item.title: About
item.description: I am a JPL Postdoctoral fellow working under the supervision of Marc Simard using airborne and satellite SAR imagery to estimate biomass and detect forest disturbances. I apply tools from computer vision and variational image processing to analyze backscatter and coherence images.
